meta.desc: Convert images to pure black and white (binary) online. Adjustable threshold for artistic high-contrast effects.

input.title: Convert Image to Black & White
input.desc: Upload your photo and convert it to a high-contrast binary black and white image.

content.title: Online Black & White Converter
content.p1: Transform your images into purely black and white art with our binary converter. Unlike standard grayscale, this tool uses only two colors: black and white.
content.p2: You can adjust the threshold level to decide which parts of the image become black and which become white, allowing for striking silhouettes and stencil-like effects.

binary.title: True Binary
binary.desc: Converts pixels to either pure black (0) or pure white (255) - no gray areas.

threshold.title: Adjustable Threshold
threshold.desc: Fine-tune the contrast cut-off point to get the perfect detail balance.

artistic.title: Artistic Effects
artistic.desc: Great for creating stencils, line art, or retro dithering-style looks.

how_to.title: How to Convert to Black & White
list: The tool initially uses a median threshold (128).
Move the Threshold slider to adjust the effect.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What is the difference between this and grayscale?
faq.a1: Grayscale keeps the shades of gray. This tool converts everything to either 100% black or 100% white.
faq.a2: The threshold value determines the brightness level where pixels switch from black to white. Lower values make the image brighter (more white), higher values make it darker (more black).
